title: SSC-1.3 — Registration And Architecture Closeout Evidence
summary: record final registration reconciliation, broader verification, durable architecture ownership, downstream handoff, and delivery omissions
content_html:
SSC-1.3 — Registration And Architecture Closeout Evidence

Outcome

SSC-1 is complete. The checked configuration contains exactly two customised collections: analysis/tags selects analysis_tags with its ordered group settings, and dotlineform/projects selects dotlineform_projects with empty settings. Each record uses the strict sub_scope_customisation: {id, settings} shape.

The Python registry repeats those two identities. Analysis Tags owns settings normalization, manifest projection, document groups, and Manage browser composition. Projects owns settings normalization, manifest projection, source validation, metadata read/update, import front matter, and Manage browser composition. Both current definitions retain an empty assignable_field_groups tuple and None transfer value. The Manage JavaScript registry contains the matching two lazy loaders and the public registry retains its empty loader map.

The final SSC-1.3 diff is a documentation-only transfer. It moves shipped-state ownership to Sub-Scope Customisation Architecture, updates current manifest/index/detail references to the unified key and module, and makes SSP-0 and TDL-0 consume the exact shipped DocsSubScopeAssignableFieldGroup, group-ID projection, server resolver, and browser availability helper.

Preserved Behavior

  • The default docs_subscope report, report host, public/Manage manifests, membership, list/detail navigation, standard Manage contribution, and exact action targets retain their established owners.
  • Analysis Tags retains ordered group validation, Manage manifest group data, the group filter, its public Concepts reader, and return-import behavior.
  • Projects retains folder validation, Manage manifest row data, metadata read/update, create-only import front matter, folder presentation, Open in Finder, and its current Folder Link metadata contribution.
  • Current Manage browser descriptors remain exactly {id}. Normalized settings and concrete fields remain server-owned; the current public descriptor and custom-manifest projection remains empty for both registrations.
  • The customisation manifest/data envelope remains the generated contribution namespace, distinct from the configured sub_scope_customisation selector.

Verification

  • Focused registry, config, builder, source-model, metadata, import, watcher, package, public-boundary, migration, and seed tests: 179 passed, 1 skipped.
  • Analysis Tags real sub-scope build: 249 documents, zero document/manifest writes, zero warnings, and unchanged Manage/public browser configs.
  • Docs Viewer smoke profile: 23 of 26 checks passed, including complete Docs Viewer source lint, site validation, the sub-scope report module smoke, and the sub-scope create/delete route smokes. Run summary: var/admin/test-runs/ssc-1-3-closeout/summary.md.
  • The profile's three remaining failures are Diagram Detail/inline-Mermaid expectation mismatches in external-local, Manage-service, and public-reader smokes. Their observed states already contain diagram-detail frames or controls; the SSC-1.3 diff contains no Mermaid or diagram-detail implementation file. Focused sub-scope and public-boundary evidence remains green.
  • Direct Python/JavaScript lint for the SSC-1.2 implementation files passed before closeout; the profile repeated the complete adopted Docs Viewer source-lint boundary successfully.
  • The configuration inventory, Python definitions, Manage/public loader registries, generated Studio documents, index tree, Recent, search .entries, JSON parsing, and current terminology were inspected directly.
  • git diff --check: passed.

Review And Downstream Boundary

The independent final review confirmed one strict configured selector, one validated definition registry, aspect-owned access, group-ID-only future browser capability projection, exact configured-collection selection, and matching current Manage loaders. Strict unified-key loading is the sole config reader, group declarations are the availability authority, and the public loader registry remains empty.

SSP-0 owns the concrete authoring_subject declaration, exact-document Info projection, focused action/modal, capability-restricted mutation, and Projects generic-metadata extraction. TDL-0 owns the concrete tag_fields declaration, read-only group projection, focused action/modal, capability-restricted mutation, and generic group extraction. Copy owns any concrete DocsSubScopeTransferAspect consumption. Implementation begins only inside those downstream deliveries.
